name: cloud_hits_air_and_ground
description: The Beekeeper's Clay Hive (contract-m6 3): no shot; every 0.3 s a bee cloud over the creep it aims at (the foremost in its 3.0 tiles) stings every creep within 0.9 tiles of that one, ground or air: the Gourdling it aims at, a Duskmoth half a tile behind it and a Gourdling 0.7 behind take 3 each, a Gourdling two tiles back none. SimTower.cloud_creep says where the cloud hangs, 0 once nothing is in reach. The Drowsy Clay Hive's stings slow 25% for 1 s, the flier's too.

steps.assert: hive.kind == 'clay_hive' and hive.cloud_mm == 900 and hive.cd_t == 18 and hive.air and hive.shot_um_t == 0
steps.msg: a Clay Hive stands: a cloud of 0.9 tiles every 18 ticks
it aims at the foremost creep, and the cloud hangs over it
it stings every creep within 0.9 tiles of it, the Duskmoth too
but not the Gourdling two tiles back
again 0.3 s later, with no shot fired

steps.assert: hive.branch == 1 and scene.creep(c[1]).slow_pm == 250 and scene.creep(c[0]).slow_pm == 250 and scene.creep(c[2]).slow_pm == 250 and scene.creep(c[3]).slow_pm == 0
steps.msg: the Drowsy Clay Hive's stings slow every creep in the cloud 25%, the flier too
with nothing in reach the cloud is gone
